---
title: "Manage your passkeys and PIN"
subtitle: "SOP MGR-08 · Manager manual"
---

## Purpose

Add or remove the passkeys that open Admin for you, and set or change your
Admin PIN.

## Applies to

Every manager, for their own profile only. Nobody can change another
manager's passkeys or PIN.

## Before you begin

- Admin is open. See [MGR-02 Open Admin](opening-admin.qmd).

## Procedure

1. Click **Passkeys and PIN** in the green bar at the top of Admin. Two
   boxes open: **Your passkeys** and **Change your PIN** (or **Set a PIN**).

   ![Passkeys and PIN](/screenshots/manager/passkeys-and-pin.png)

### Add a passkey

2. Click **Name it** and type a name for the device, for example "Nadia's
   phone".
3. Click **Add a passkey** and follow the prompt on your device.

### Remove a passkey

2. Under **Your passkeys**, click **Remove** beside the passkey. You cannot
   remove your last way in.

### Set or change your PIN

A PIN is for when your phone is dead or not with you.

2. Click **New PIN (4 to 8 digits)** and type the new PIN.
3. Click **Save PIN**.

### Finish

4. Click **Done** in the green bar.

## Result

The green bar shows **Passkey added.** or **PIN saved.** The next time you
open Admin, the new passkey or PIN works.
